# Skill market ZIP fixtures

These archives are generated by `generate.ts`. The generator writes central-directory Unix modes and Info-ZIP extra fields directly so the same attack metadata is exercised on macOS, Linux, and Windows.

| Archive         | Entry                    | Unix mode | Compressed |    Expanded | Purpose                              |
| --------------- | ------------------------ | --------: | ---------: | ----------: | ------------------------------------ |
| `valid.zip`     | `SKILL.md`               | `0100644` |       61 B |        72 B | Valid root manifest                  |
| `valid.zip`     | `references/guide.md`    | `0100644` |       54 B |        52 B | Valid nested file                    |
| `traversal.zip` | `../outside.txt`         | `0100644` |        8 B |         6 B | Parent traversal                     |
| `absolute.zip`  | `/tmp/ruying-escape.txt` | `0100644` |        8 B |         6 B | POSIX absolute path                  |
| `symlink.zip`   | `SKILL.md`               | `0120777` |        8 B |         6 B | Symbolic link                        |
| `hardlink.zip`  | `SKILL.md`               | `0100644` |        8 B |         6 B | Info-ZIP Unix `0x000d` link metadata |
| `bomb.zip`      | `SKILL.md`               | `0100644` |    1,034 B | 1,048,576 B | Compression-ratio limit              |
